title: pref/{site}/import payload
description: UPSERT payload of pref/{site}/import: the user's import preferences (import.proto WHAT AN IMPORT DOES WITH A DECISION), read when an import starts. Serialized, at most 221 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

import_policy.description: A conflict: ASK (a figure item, the default), FAVOR_APP (settled as keep) or FAVOR_MFC (settled as take), each recorded with an undo.

mfc_only.description: A change only MFC made to a figure the import knew: APPLY_AND_LIST (written, and listed with an undo; the default) or HOLD (a figure item until confirmed).

disposition_list.description: The MFC list the user keeps sold and traded items in (e.g. 206369), for the align-MFC entries. A 0.3.0 import writes no disposal from it.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
